title: Job Interview
goals: mengenali tahapan **job interview**: salam, perkenalan, pertanyaan inti, dan penutup
menjawab pertanyaan umum: [[Tell me about yourself.]], [[Why do you want this job?]], [[What are your strengths?]]
memakai ungkapan sopan dan profesional dalam wawancara
menceritakan pengalaman dan kemampuan dengan **simple past** dan **present perfect**
berlatih dialog wawancara kerja dari awal sampai akhir

lesson.text: Setelah surat lamaran diterima, langkah berikutnya adalah **wawancara kerja** (*job interview*). Pewawancara ingin tahu siapa kamu, apa kemampuanmu, dan mengapa kamu cocok. Dengan latihan, jawaban yang **jelas, jujur, dan sopan** akan membuatmu percaya diri.

lesson.title: 1. Tahapan wawancara
table: [[Good morning. Thank you for seeing me.]]
[[Please tell me about yourself.]] / [[My name is Dina Putri.]]
[[Why do you want to work here?]]
[[Could you tell me more about the job?]]
[[Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.]]

lesson.title: 2. Pertanyaan umum dan cara menjawab
table: [[I graduated from SMK Negeri 1 in 2025. I enjoy working with people.]]
[[I want to learn and use my skills in a professional team.]]
[[I am responsible, punctual, and a quick learner.]]
[[Sometimes I am too careful, but I am learning to work faster.]]
[[Yes, I did an internship at a travel agency for three months.]]
[[Yes, I can. I stay calm and make a plan.]]
[[Where do you see yourself in five years?]]
[[I hope to become a skilled and trusted employee.]]

items.ex: He is a good team player.
What is the salary for this position?
The probation period is three months.
My achievement was winning a contest.
The company will train new staff.

lesson.title: 4. Ungkapan sopan dan profesional
table: [[Could you repeat the question, please?]] / [[I'm sorry, could you say that again?]]
[[I am able to ...]] / [[I am good at ...]] / [[I can ...]]
[[I have worked as ... for ...]] / [[I was responsible for ...]]
[[What are the working hours?]] / [[Is there any training?]]

lesson.title: Hindari jawaban kasual dan berlebihan
lesson.text: Jangan jawab dengan [[Yeah]], [[Nope]], atau [[Whatever]]. Gunakan [[Yes]], [[No]], [[Certainly]]. Jangan berbohong dan jangan menjelekkan tempat kerja lama. Jawab singkat, jelas, disertai **contoh**.

lesson.title: 5. Tense yang dipakai
table: [[I worked at a cafe last year.]]

lines.en: Good morning, Dina. Please have a seat.
Good morning, Mr. Adi. Thank you for seeing me.
lines.id: Selamat pagi, Pak Adi. Terima kasih sudah menerima saya.

lines.en: I graduated from SMK Negeri 1 Bandung in 2025. I did an internship at a travel agency for three months, and I enjoy working with people.
lines.id: Saya lulus dari SMK Negeri 1 Bandung tahun 2025. Saya magang di biro perjalanan selama tiga bulan, dan saya senang bekerja dengan orang.

lines.en: Why do you want to work here?
lines.id: Mengapa kamu ingin bekerja di sini?

lines.en: Because your company is well known for good service, and I want to learn from a professional team.
lines.id: Karena perusahaan Anda terkenal dengan pelayanan yang baik, dan saya ingin belajar dari tim profesional.

lines.en: I am responsible, punctual, and a quick learner.
lines.id: Saya bertanggung jawab, tepat waktu, dan cepat belajar.

lines.en: Do you have any questions for me?
lines.id: Apakah kamu punya pertanyaan untuk saya?

lines.en: Yes. What are the working hours, and is there any training for new staff?
lines.id: Ya. Berapa jam kerjanya, dan apakah ada pelatihan untuk staf baru?

lines.en: The working hours are from eight to four, and we train new staff for two weeks.
lines.id: Jam kerjanya pukul delapan sampai empat, dan kami melatih staf baru selama dua minggu.

lines.en: Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.
lines.id: Terima kasih atas waktu Anda. Saya menantikan kabar dari Anda.

lines.en: We will contact you next week.

lesson.title: Persiapan wawancara
lesson.text: Pelajari perusahaan, latih jawaban untuk pertanyaan umum, datang **tepat waktu**, berpakaian rapi, tersenyum, dan lihat mata pewawancara. Gunakan pola **jawaban + contoh**: [[I am responsible. For example, I finished every task on time during my internship.]]

items: Tahapan: salam, perkenalan, pertanyaan inti, bertanya balik, penutup.
Pertanyaan umum: [[Tell me about yourself.]], [[Why do you want this job?]], [[What are your strengths?]]
Jawab dengan **jelas, jujur, sopan**, sertakan contoh nyata.
Tense: simple present (sifat), simple past (pengalaman), present perfect (sampai sekarang), will (komitmen).
Akhiri dengan [[Thank you for your time.]]

She says she is always late for every meeting.
She says she hates talking to customers.
qs.q: What does Anita say about her weakness?

read.text:
Interviewer: Good morning, Ms. Anita. Please tell me about yourself.
Anita: Good morning. I graduated from Airlangga University with a degree in Psychology. For the last two years, I have worked as a customer service officer at a telecommunication company.
Interviewer: What is your greatest strength? Anita: I am a good listener, so I can understand customers' problems quickly. Interviewer: And your weakness? Anita: Sometimes I spend too much time on details, but I am learning to manage my time better.
read.title: A Job Interview

read.id:
Mempersiapkan wawancara kerja sama pentingnya dengan menulis CV yang baik. Pertama, pelajari perusahaan agar kamu dapat menjelaskan mengapa kamu ingin bekerja di sana. Kedua, berlatihlah menjawab pertanyaan umum seperti "Mengapa kami harus mempekerjakan Anda?"
Pada hari wawancara, berpakaianlah rapi dan tiba sepuluh menit lebih awal. Jaga kontak mata dan bicaralah dengan jelas. Di akhir, jangan lupa mengajukan satu atau dua pertanyaan tentang pekerjaan. Terakhir, kirim email terima kasih dalam 24 jam.

qs.exp: Teks: "so that you can explain why you want to work there."
options: To explain why you want to work there
To find its address and the best way to get there
To ask for money before the interview starts
To criticize it during the interview in front of everyone
qs.q: Why should you research the company?
When should you arrive on interview day?

qs.exp: Teks: "ask one or two questions about the job."
qs.q: What should you do at the end of the interview?

qs.exp: Teks: "send a thank-you email within 24 hours."
options: A bill for the time spent at the interview
A photo of yourself in the office
A gift for the interviewer and the staff
qs.q: What should you send after the interview?

read.text:
Preparing for a job interview is just as important as writing a good CV. First, research the company so that you can explain why you want to work there. Second, practise answering common questions such as "Why should we hire you?"
On the interview day, dress neatly and arrive ten minutes early. Maintain eye contact and speak clearly. At the end, don't forget to ask one or two questions about the job. Finally, send a thank-you email within 24 hours.
read.title: Interview Tips

read.focus: Present perfect dan simple past untuk pengalaman
read.id:
Rizky punya wawancara besok untuk pekerjaan desainer junior. Dia sudah mempersiapkan diri dengan baik. Dia sudah membaca tentang perusahaan itu dan sudah berlatih pertanyaan umum bersama kakaknya.
Kemarin, dia memperbarui CV-nya dan menambahkan proyek yang dia selesaikan tahun lalu. Dia akan memberi tahu pewawancara bahwa dia sudah mengerjakan lima proyek sejak 2022, dan bahwa dia belajar banyak keterampilan dari proyek-proyek itu. Dia gugup, tetapi dia yakin persiapan yang baik membuat kesan yang baik.

qs.q: What job is Rizky applying for?
What did Rizky do yesterday?

qs.exp: Present perfect + since → pengalaman sampai sekarang.
options: He wants to show his experience up to now.
He is telling a story that ended long ago.
He is planning what he will do next year.
He is giving an order to the interviewer.
qs.q: Why does Rizky say "he has worked on five projects since 2022"?
Pasangkan istilah wawancara dengan artinya:
Rizky ___ (read) about the company.
Yesterday, he ___ (update) his CV.
Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Dia sudah mempersiapkan diri dengan baik."

read.text:
Rizky has an interview tomorrow for a junior designer job. He has prepared well. He has read about the company and has practised common questions with his sister.
Yesterday, he updated his CV and added a project that he completed last year. He will tell the interviewer that he has worked on five projects since 2022, and that he learned many skills from them. He is nervous, but he believes that good preparation makes a good impression.
read.title: Preparing for an Interview

read.focus: Present perfect continuous, past simple, dan future
read.id:
Hana baru saja menyelesaikan wawancaranya di sebuah perusahaan perjalanan. Dia sudah menunggu kesempatan ini selama berbulan-bulan, dan dia berlatih menjawab setiap malam. Pewawancara bertanya tentang pengalamannya, dan dia menjelaskan bahwa dia pernah bekerja sebagai pemandu wisata selama tiga tahun.
Hana awalnya gugup, tetapi dia menjadi percaya diri ketika membicarakan perjalanan favoritnya. "Kami akan menghubungi Anda paling lambat Jumat," kata pewawancara. Sekarang Hana memeriksa ponselnya setiap beberapa menit. Jika dia mendapat pekerjaan itu, dia akan mulai bulan depan.

qs.exp: Teks: "she had worked as a tour guide for three years".
options: She worked as a tour guide for three years.
She studied abroad for three years.
She was a teacher at a language school.
She sold tickets at a train station.
qs.q: What did Hana do before?

qs.exp: Present perfect continuous: has been + V-ing.
options: She has been practice her answers every evening.
She has been practicing her answers every evening.
She has just finished her interview.
The interviewer asked about her experience.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Teks: "We will contact you by Friday".
qs.q: When will the company contact Hana?
Pasangkan ungkapan wawancara dengan fungsinya:
Hana ___ (wait) for this chance for months.
If she gets the job, she ___ (start) next month.

qs.answer: Hana has just finished her interview.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Hana baru saja menyelesaikan wawancaranya."

read.text:
Hana has just finished her interview at a travel company. She has been waiting for this chance for months, and she has been practicing her answers every evening. The interviewer asked her about her experience, and she explained that she had worked as a tour guide for three years.
Hana felt nervous at first, but she became confident when she talked about her favorite trips. "We will contact you by Friday," the interviewer said. Now Hana is checking her phone every few minutes. If she gets the job, she will start next month.
read.title: After the Interview

read.focus: Future continuous dan future perfect dalam wawancara
read.id:
Pewawancara: Di mana Anda melihat diri Anda lima tahun lagi? Sinta: Pada saat itu, saya sudah menyelesaikan gelar magister, dan akan bekerja sebagai manajer proyek. Saya akan sudah memimpin setidaknya tiga proyek besar.
Pewawancara: Anda akan sedang melakukan apa tahun depan? Sinta: Saya akan sedang belajar di malam hari, dan bekerja di siang hari. Pada akhir bulan ini, saya sudah menyelesaikan kursus pertama. Pewawancara: Kedengarannya ambisius.

qs.exp: Sinta: "I will have completed my master's degree".
options: A new job at another company
A language course in the evenings
qs.q: What will Sinta have completed in five years?

options: By then, I will complete my degree already.
By then, I will have completed my degree.
I will be working as a project manager.
I will be studying in the evenings.
qs.q: Which sentence has a mistake?

qs.exp: Sinta: "I will be studying in the evenings, and I will be working during the day."
options: Studying in the evenings and working by day
Traveling abroad for a whole year
Looking for a job in another city
Resting at home before a new course
qs.q: What will Sinta be doing next year?
Pasangkan bentuk dengan fungsinya:
By then, I ___ (complete) my master's degree.
I ___ (work) as a project manager in five years.

qs.answer: I will be studying in the evenings.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Saya akan sedang belajar di malam hari."

read.text:
Interviewer: Where do you see yourself in five years? Sinta: By then, I will have completed my master's degree, and I will be working as a project manager. I will have led at least three big projects.
Interviewer: What will you be doing next year? Sinta: I will be studying in the evenings, and I will be working during the day. By the end of this month, I will have finished my first course. Interviewer: That sounds ambitious.
read.title: Five Years from Now
